remarks: Location, location! Situated down a private drive sits this beautifully maintained Colonial home. Light pours in from the windows of every room, which also provide views of this bucolic setting. Hardwood floors throughout, two fireplaces. Spacious living room with fireplace, dining room, eat-in kitchen and office/guest room with full bath and powder room complete the first floor. Spacious primary suite, plus three additional bedrooms, and one full bath. Family room on lower level. Close to schools, train, shops, restaurants, beach, train and I95 for an easy commute to NYC!
